The live s7.3 contract<->source merge (crates/vibe-spec/src/merge.rs) is section-grain and fact-blind: facts ride as opaque body text. Three unspecified joints with the fact amendment: (1) :add (the DEFAULT) concatenates contract+source section bodies - a fact id declared on both sides becomes a DUPLICATE in the merged view, and no gate sees it (per-file checks are clean; the compiled artifact is scanned by nobody); (2) :replace drops contract facts from the compiled view wholesale (source-file specmap resolution unaffected; compiled-view readers lose the ids); (3) there is no per-fact override gesture - overriding one statement requires :replace of the whole section. Fact-inheritance mechanism needs ratifying into PROP-035 s5 (IR fact leaves) + s7.3 (fact-merge clause), mirrored in PROP-014 s2.1; implementation would be a host DRIFT (vibe-spec merge/doctree/router).
